name: wayland-agent helper
description: Exposes window and monitor metadata to the wayland-agent daemon via the com.mxshift.WaylandAgent D-Bus interface. Lets unprivileged callers enumerate windows, focus a window, and read monitor layout/scale — data that GNOME's built-in org.gnome.Shell.Introspect API gates behind a hardcoded caller whitelist. Also adds a Quick Settings toggle that starts/stops the wayland-agent daemon's systemd user unit.
